research.title: Image Quality Baselines for Surface Defect Classification
bullets: Prepared labeled surface images by checking annotation consistency, removing duplicate captures, and maintaining separate training and evaluation sets grouped by specimen.
Implemented a prescribed baseline using local texture descriptors and a support vector classifier, reviewing classification errors across lighting conditions and defect categories.

research.title: Color and Texture Features for Plant Image Classification
bullets: Organized plant image annotations, standardized image dimensions, and checked dataset partitions for repeated photographs before preparing inputs for classification experiments.
Implemented assigned color histogram and texture feature baselines with logistic regression, documenting confusion patterns associated with background clutter and leaf orientation.

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded inventory discrepancies, and routed damaged or missing items to the appropriate staff for follow-up.
Prepared order paperwork, maintained filing records, and coordinated routine pickup schedules while communicating order status updates to customers and internal staff.

projects.title: Handwritten Character Recognition with Classical Image Features
bullets: Implemented a character recognition baseline using normalized grayscale images, histogram of oriented gradients features, and a support vector classifier.
Compared feature-based predictions with a raw-pixel nearest-neighbor baseline, inspecting confusion matrices and misclassified examples to characterize visually similar character errors.
